name: ADBICA
summary: ADBICA (also known as ADB-PICA) is a designer drug identified in synthetic cannabis blends in Japan in 2013. ADBICA had not previously been reported in the scientific literature prior to its sale as a component of synthetic cannabis blends. ADBICA features a carboxamide group at the 3-indole position, like SDB-001 and STS-135.

pharmacology.text: ADBICA is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and CB2 receptor with an EC50 value of 0.69 nM and 1.8 nM respectively.

uses.text: ADBICA (also known as ADB-PICA) is a designer drug identified in synthetic cannabis blends in Japan in 2013.

summaryZh: ADBICA，化學名N-(1-氨甲醯基-2,2-二甲基丙基)-1-戊基吲哚-3-甲醯胺（英語：N--1-pentyl-1H-indole-3-carboxamide，也稱為 ADB-PICA）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C20H29N3O2，屬於3-吲哚甲醯胺衍生物，可作為合成大麻素，2013年在日本發現，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: It had never appeared in the scientific literature before it turned up for sale in synthetic cannabis blends in Japan in 2013, so the market saw it before researchers did.
fact.zh: 在2013年於日本的合成大麻混合草料中出現之前，它從未出現在科學文獻中，因此市場比研究者更早見到它。
fact.zhHans: 在2013年于日本的合成大麻混合草料中出现之前，它从未出现在科学文献中，因此市场比研究者更早见到它。
